newsitem.title: USA: US stocks steady near highs, chip equip cos strong.
newsitem.headline: US stocks steady near highs, chip equip cos strong.

text.p: U.S. stocks were steady near their highs with the Nasdaq composite leading the broader market in contrast to recent sessions.
Nasdaq stocks were up 9.81 to 1267.89, or 0.78 percent, in early trading. The Dow industrials were up about 30 to 6448, or 0.45 percent. IBM shares rose 3-1/8 to 157.
The Russell 2000 index of small stocks and the Standard & Poor's 500-stock index were also up about as much as the Dow on a percentage basis.
